findings.description: The join separator conditional was inverted during the move. The original code used "; " when any_prefix_is_slash was true and " / " otherwise. The new code uses "; " when it is false and " / " when it is true.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option with both primary and secondary opts, such as a boolean flag like --shout/--no-shout. Mechanism: the swapped ternary picks the wrong separator. Impact: help output changes from "--shout / --no-shout" to "--shout; --no-shout", and slash-prefixed options (/debug; /no-debug) get " / " instead of "; ". This is a regression in every help screen with secondary opts.
